content: We used ROUGE BIBREF41 to measure the quality of different summarization model outputs. We reported full-length F1 based ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L scores on CNNDM, while we used the limited-length recall based ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L on NYT following BIBREF36. The ROUGE scores are computed using the ROUGE-1.5.5.pl script.
